rules.title: Passwordless root or administrator access
rules.description: The skill grants root or administrator rights that need no password. A NOPASSWD sudoers rule removes the password check for the commands it names, `ALL` names every command, and an admin grant does the same for a user.

kind.subject: frame
kind.question: What does the marked text do with root or administrator rights that need no password?

options.grant: it adds or writes a rule that grants passwordless sudo or administrator rights.
options.removal-or-check: it removes such a rule, or checks whether one exists.
options.example-not-to-do: it shows such a rule as an example of what not to do.
options.not-a-match: the marked text is not about root or administrator rights that need no password.

rules.title: Passwordless privilege grant assembled out of sight
rules.description: The skill grants root or administrator rights that need no password, and the sudoers line, registry value or group command is joined at run time, decoded, or read from a downloaded file. There are very limited valid reasons for a skill to do so ever.
